settings._note: KOR NetworkOps remote screen. LAN + VPN only (ufw). Built 2026-09-30; cleaned up 2026-10-01 (branding, consent wording, idle timeout, admin pages trimmed).

domains.title: KOR Remote
domains._titleHtml: The signed-in header (siteStyle 3 shows titleHtml, not titlePicture). logo.png is served from titlePicture.
domains.welcomeText: Remote help for KOR staff and machines. Reachable from the office network and the VPN only.
domains._myServer: The server's own admin pages: backups are Veeam's (the VM), upgrades are pinned by npm, so none of these is used from the browser.
domains._consentMessages: What a person at the PC sees when someone connects. {0} is the name of who is connecting.

consentMessages.title: KOR Remote
consentMessages.desktop: {0} from KOR IT would like to see your screen to help. Allow?
consentMessages.terminal: {0} from KOR IT would like to open a command window on this PC. Allow?
consentMessages.files: {0} from KOR IT would like to see the files on this PC. Allow?

notificationMessages.title: KOR Remote
notificationMessages.desktop: {0} from KOR IT is viewing your screen.
notificationMessages.terminal: {0} from KOR IT has a command window open on this PC.
notificationMessages.files: {0} from KOR IT is looking at the files on this PC.

domains._agentCustomization: Names a NEW install shows (tray, consent bar). NOT serviceName: NetworkOps' installer and the Webroot override rely on the existing service and folder.
